name: The Ruins
description: A beautiful ruined mansion with Italian architecture, often called the 'Taj Mahal of Negros'. Built in the early 1900s, it's one of Bacolod's most iconic landmarks. The structure glows beautifully at sunset and is surrounded by gardens.

name: Masskara Festival
description: Annual festival celebrating Bacolod's smiling culture, held every October. Features colorful masks, street dancing, food fairs, and cultural performances. Known as the 'Festival of Smiles'.

name: Chicken Inasal
description: Bacolod's signature grilled chicken dish, marinated in local spices and cooked over hot coals. Served with garlic rice and sinamak (spiced vinegar). A must-try local delicacy.

name: Campuestohan Highland Resort
description: Mountain resort offering zip lines, hanging bridges, swimming pools, and cool mountain air. Perfect for families and adventure seekers. Features themed attractions and scenic views.

name: San Sebastian Cathedral
description: Historic Catholic cathedral built in 1882, featuring beautiful architecture and stained glass windows. A peaceful place for reflection and appreciation of Bacolod's religious heritage.

name: Negros Museum
description: Museum showcasing Negros Occidental's rich history, culture, and heritage. Features artifacts, exhibits, and interactive displays about the sugar industry and local traditions.

name: Pasalubong Center
description: One-stop shop for Bacolod delicacies and souvenirs including piaya, napoleones, and other local treats. Perfect for bringing home a taste of Bacolod.

name: Magikland Theme Park
description: Family-friendly theme park with rides, attractions, and entertainment. Great for families with children and those seeking fun and adventure.

name: Balay Negrense
description: Heritage house museum showcasing the lifestyle of Negrense sugar barons during the late 19th century. Features period furniture and antiques.

location.address: Cinco de Noviembre Street, Silay City

name: Lacson Street (Heritage Walk)
description: Famous street lined with heritage houses and colonial architecture. Perfect for a leisurely walk to admire Bacolod's architectural heritage and take photos.

name: Mambukal Mountain Resort
description: Natural hot springs resort with swimming pools, hiking trails, and waterfalls. Perfect for nature lovers and those seeking relaxation. Features 7 waterfalls and sulfur hot springs.

name: Calea Pastries & Coffee
description: Famous bakery and cafe known for delicious cakes, pastries, and coffee. A favorite among locals and tourists. Try their signature chocolate cakes and cheesecakes.

name: L'Fisher Hotel
description: Landmark hotel on Lacson Street with pool, restaurant, and event spaces. Central location for exploring Bacolod's heritage and dining.

name: Seda Capitol Central
description: Modern hotel near Capitol Park with rooftop bar, pool, and dining. Great for social travelers and business.

name: Go Hotels Bacolod
description: Budget-friendly hotel near the airport and city center. Clean, comfortable rooms for practical travelers.
